title: Infinity Receipt v2
description: A decision receipt. Its id is the SHA3-256 of every other field below, including issued_at (v1 left issued_at out). Hash-linked, not signed.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC, e.g. 2026-10-02T10:15:00Z. Supplied by the caller of the kernel; covered by the hash.

call_digest.description: Present when the proposal bound a call. Covered by the receipt hash when present, and omitted when it is not, so older receipts keep their ids. The kernel copies it; it does not check it against a call.

caller_id.description: Present when the proposal named a caller. Covered by the receipt hash when present, and omitted when it is not, so older receipts keep their ids. The kernel copies it from the proposal. It does not verify a token.

key_id.description: Present only on signed entries; names the public key to check the signature with.

signature.description: Ed25519 over the entry id with a domain prefix. Not part of the hash. Needs a trusted public key to mean anything.
